topic: First Davis Cup (International Lawn Tennis Challenge), 8–10 August 1900, Longwood Cricket Club, Boston: United States beat the British Isles 3–0; conceived by 4 Harvard players; Dwight F. Davis bought the sterling trophy; all-time titles USA 32, Australia 28, GB 10, France 10.
policy_note: Every spoken or shown fact → a claim with ≥ 2 independent publishers; core claims need a primary/scholarly source.

myths.myth: The Davis Cup began in England, the home of lawn tennis.
myths.reality: It began in Boston as an American challenge to the British; Britain won its first Cup only in 1903.
